original_bug_mechanism: IPv4-mapped IPv6 text expands to mixed dotted-decimal notation which the legacy parser misinterprets.
synthetic_bug_mechanism: Address classification checks a fixed 16-bit prefix instead of the full fe80::/10 link-local range.
distinctness: The original upstream fix is retained. Address classification checks a fixed 16-bit prefix instead of the full fe80::/10 link-local range.
oracle: fe9a::1 and febf::1 must be link-local; fec0::1 must not. Parsing and mapped-address regressions must still pass.
realism: Replacing an address-library predicate with an overly specific byte-prefix optimization loses prefix-mask semantics.
test_changes: Minimal additions to the existing regression suite; original tests and assertions preserved.
